experiment: E37 robust SPD residual MLP with reciprocal-point open-space loss

data.source: Train session1 only; read-only reuse of E36 feature cache and Train MAT files
data.outer_status: run once only if every preregistered inner gate passes; otherwise N/A

smoke.purpose: gradient, speed and CUDA memory only; never a metric conclusion or model-selection input

model.whitening: fit-fold-only WCCN, shrinkage 0.05, eigenvalue floor 1e-6; frozen during MLP training
model.prototypes: trainable normalized class prototypes initialized from the same fit-fold WCCN prototypes
model.initial_equivalence: zero residual gives exactly the E36 WCCN cosine model before optimization

arpl.open_space_loss: mean MarginRankingLoss(radius, true-class mean squared distance, target=1, margin=1) plus MarginRankingLoss(radius, nearest other-class mean squared distance, target=-1, margin=1); the second term was added 2026-11-13 because the one-sided form let the radius collapse and pushed every embedding away from all prototypes
arpl.note: reciprocal-point-style loss on normalized residual embeddings; no confusing-sample generator and no unknown training labels

training.early_stopping_data: only the corresponding inner clean known and pseudo-unknown validation split
training.early_stopping_metric: 100*C^0.40*U^0.25 at validation-known q05; ties by direct C, identity macro-F1, AUROC, U@95, then earlier epoch
training.prototype_anchor_note: added 2026-11-13 after smoke showed trainable prototypes drifting and destroying identity accuracy; anchors normalized prototypes to their fit-fold WCCN initialization
training.training_labels: always true identity, including after targeted attack generation
training.target_rule: next registered identity in sorted enrolled-class cycle
training.snr_mix: equal-probability SNR20/SNR30 per batch using fold/epoch/batch-seeded RNG
training.mixed_attack_mix: equal-probability untargeted/targeted per batch; non-targeted AT is always untargeted
training.shared_seed_rule: model initialization, shuffling and SNR choices do not depend on variant; only the preregistered attack factor changes
training.full_train_capacity: after inner completion, fit each variant on all Train for the rounded median of its ten inner best epochs; no early stopping or model selection; accuracy is capacity only

feature_attack.space: frozen WCCN-whitened 855-dimensional features before residual MLP
feature_attack.step_size: 2*epsilon/7 with L2-normalized gradient and per-sample L2 projection
feature_attack.initialization: seeded random direction with radius uniformly scaled in [0,1)
feature_attack.loss: cross_entropy(current cosine scores / 0.05); maximize untargeted and minimize targeted

epsilon_calibration.source: the same fit fold's initial zero-residual full raw-waveform PGD20 model, before residual training
epsilon_calibration.subset: first 1 trial per fit subject/task after trial/path sort
epsilon_calibration.displacement: L2 norm of (attacked detrend-zband - clean detrend-zband) @ frozen whitening
epsilon_calibration.selection: separate pooled 95th percentile for SNR20 and SNR30 across untargeted and targeted calibration displacements
epsilon_calibration.restriction: fixed before training/evaluation; never adjusted from clean or adversarial evaluation results

evaluation.inner_folds: E36 five outer groups x two inner folds, identical seeds and continuous trial blocks
evaluation.subset: E36 stratified first 8 trials per identity/task by trial/path; no outcome-based sampling
evaluation.differentiable_chain: raw EEG -> gpu_logspd -> detrend-zband -> frozen WCCN whitening -> current residual MLP -> normalized prototypes; float64 attack features and model
evaluation.threshold_grid: 101 evenly spaced quantiles from 0 to 0.05 of corresponding pooled inner clean-known confidence
evaluation.threshold_objective: maximize macro 100*C^0.40*A^0.35*U^0.25 over all six attacks; E36 tie breaks and score order
evaluation.joint_f1: macro-F1 over label 0 plus the union of enrolled identities in the two corresponding inner runs
evaluation.direct_ra_rule: direct RA below 0.95 can never be described as a passing thresholded defense

targets.aggregation: mean of five outer-fold results, each pooling its two corresponding inner runs
targets.outer_rule: select only among variants passing every inner gate by macro Score, RA, ASafeR, C; if none passes, outer remains N/A and no further search is allowed

reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only pseudo-unknown and continuous file-block proxy; smoke is not evidence; full-Train fit is capacity only; no Test or cross-session claim
